zh: 添加按浏览器设置的轻量提醒：任务结束、等待确认、标题、声音和系统通知，支持返回对应对话、可见对话安静及后台子代理过滤。直接监听共享运行状态，不加载历史；系统通知需 HTTPS 与浏览器授权。
en: Add device-local reminders for finished tasks and requests for input, with title, sound and system channels, links back to conversations, visible-conversation quiet mode and background subagent filtering. Subscribe to shared live status without loading history. System notifications require HTTPS and permission.
